'''Never Say Diet!''' (Japanese: '''ダイエットするでちゅ！''' ''Let's Diet!'') is the 29th chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
{{TP|Pistachio|Bulbasaur}} is one pound overweight. She believes she must slim down for [[Pistachio]], so she and [[Hazel]] take a trip to a very twisted diet center.
